Products & medicine guidance

Learn how to ask about Siddha medicine and product availability safely.

Medicine guidance

Careful choices, personal advice

Products and medicines should be selected for the person, the condition, and the full medicines list—not as a one-size-fits-all purchase.

✳

Clinician guidance

Discuss whether a medicine or product is suitable for your health concern and existing care plan.

◉

Know the ingredients

Ask what a product contains, how it is used, and whether it has known risks or interactions.

↗

Follow up

Report side effects or changing symptoms, and keep follow-up with your usual treating clinician.

Ask the clinic about availability ↗

Please note: This page does not offer online diagnosis or self-prescribing. Do not stop prescribed medicines or rely on product claims that promise a cure.
